title: Functional Test Report
subtitle: AASTAR Price Dashboard
meta: Branch SIT. Before fixes: f127d70 (+ 1dc6a24). After fixes: eb0225b

Isolated local QA copy: API 127.0.0.1:8710 with APP_ENV=prod, frontend localhost:5181, throwaway PostgreSQL 18 (port 5546) with the production role layout, demo prices from 2024 and synthetic Google-Sheet data; integrations off
Claude Code (prod-readiness-checks), for the AASTAR project team
PASS after fixes - API 204/206 pass, UI 42/43 pass, 0 failures; 3 blocked by the QA environment

blocks.p: Every API route group and every page of the dashboard was tested with positive and negative cases against an isolated QA copy running with production settings. **249 scenarios** were designed and executed: 206 through the API suite and 43 in the browser. The first run found **17 defects** (3 Medium, 14 Low, none Critical or High). All 17 are fixed, covered by tests and re-checked.

**Verdict:** functionally ready. Nothing is open from this test. The three blocked scenarios need a configured Claude key (News upload validation), a 30-minute wait (idle timeout, verified in the database instead: 30 min idle, 12 h absolute) or device emulation (mobile layout) - check them on staging.

bullets: **Environment:** local QA copy - API on 127.0.0.1:8710 (APP_ENV=prod, so no API docs and no synthetic data unless explicitly allowed), Vite frontend on localhost:5181 proxying /api, throwaway PostgreSQL 18 on port 5546 with the production roles (the API connects as the least-privilege aastar_app).
**Data:** demo LSEG prices from 2024-01-02 (436 series), the four Google-Sheet sources loaded from synthetic grids, 94 HVO/SAF plants. No production data.
**Accounts:** a QA admin generated with random credentials (never printed); analyst, viewer and disabled users created per run with the prefix qa-ft-.
**Tools:** qa/functional/api-suite.mjs (Node, idempotent, writes results.json), the in-app browser for UI scenarios, and the existing backend tests and frontend build.
**Out of scope:** real integrations (LSEG, Claude, CFTC, Google, DWS Hub) - switched off, never contacted; no background worker (queued jobs stay queued); load testing.

blocks.p: Post-fix status. "PASS (fixed)" failed before its fix; "PASS (test corrected)" was a test-design error (section 4).

blocks.p: **Test-design corrections (not defects):** FT-HLT-02 pinned the migration name 0007_sheets - it now expects the shipped head (0008_hardening after the fixes). FT-SHT-05 expected the old docstring's "pipeline.run may refresh"; the route is admin-only by design (F-09). FT-AI-03 had a check bug fixed during the first run.

**Observations:** without a worker, queued jobs never run, so the CFTC and Sheet sources pages show "Refreshing…" until a worker starts - an artefact of this QA stack, not of production. AI reports and News documents are shared between users who hold the module (see the penetration test, PT-AC-07).
